# schnellefragen

> Free all-in-one moderation bot for Discord: moderation, auto-mod, logging, tickets, verification and welcome messages. Verified app on Discord, developed and run independently by schnellefragen since May 2026. The bot replies in English.

- Add to Discord: https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=1506754424276521091
- Support server: https://discord.gg/schnellefragen
- Contact: schnellefragen@gmail.com
- Price: free, no paid tier
- Permissions: only what its features use, no Administrator
- Setup: run /setup, a step-by-step wizard for logs, welcome messages and verification
- Data: settings, warnings and tickets; no message content; data of servers that remove the bot is deleted after 30 days

## Pages

- [Commands](https://schnellefragen.github.io/commands): all 43 commands with the Discord permission each one needs
- [Guides](https://schnellefragen.github.io/guides): setup, moderation, auto-mod, audit logs, welcome messages, verification, tickets, outage alerts and troubleshooting
- [Terms of Service](https://schnellefragen.github.io/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://schnellefragen.github.io/privacy)
